emails.title: Emails
emails.description: Email addresses to check. Forms like "Jane <jane@acme.io>" and "mailto:" links are cleaned up. Duplicates are skipped.

emailsText.title: Emails as text
emailsText.description: Optional. Paste a whole column or CSV text; addresses can be separated by new lines, commas, semicolons or spaces.

checkDns.title: Check mail servers (DNS)
checkDns.description: Look up MX records for every domain (cached per domain). Turn off for a syntax, disposable and typo check only.
